answer: The vine schedule is applied in kernel and mirror shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4764 identities would post 1026 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
